name: demo-studio
description: Claude skills for authoring scenarios, themes and components with Demo Studio, and the Demo Studio MCP server on one workspace.

node.title: Node.js 22 or later
node.description: Absolute path of the node binary that runs the server (studio mcp --print-config prints one).

studio.title: Demo Studio entry point
studio.description: Absolute path of packages/cli/dist/bin.js in the Demo Studio repository (built with pnpm build).

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Absolute path of the workspace folder the server works on (its studio.yaml or projects/ folder).

home.title: Studio home (optional)
home.description: Absolute path of the studio home (signed-in profiles, approval key). Empty: ~/.demo-studio.
